title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Ground model answers in your own changing knowledge: chunking, embedding search, hybrid retrieval, citations, and abstention.
outcomes: Explain when RAG beats prompting and fine-tuning for knowledge problems
Design ingestion and chunking that preserves findability
Combine semantic and keyword retrieval, and rerank
Enforce citations and abstention, and evaluate retrieval separately from answers

lessons.title: Why retrieval: grounding models in your knowledge
Chunking, embedding search, and hybrid retrieval
Production RAG: freshness, permissions, and scale
